from machine import Pin, SPI
import framebuf
import time


class ST7789:
    def __init__(self, spi, dc, cs, rst, width=240, height=240):
        self.spi, self.width, self.height = spi, width, height
        self.dc = Pin(dc, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.cs = Pin(cs, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.rst = Pin(rst, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.rst(0)
        time.sleep_ms(10)
        self.rst(1)
        time.sleep_ms(120)
        for c, a in ((0x01, b''), (0x11, b''), (0x3A, b'\x55'), (0x36, b'\x00'), (0x21, b''), (0x29, b'')):
            self._cmd(c, a)
            time.sleep_ms(10)

    def _cmd(self, c, data=b''):
        self.cs(0)
        self.dc(0)
        self.spi.write(bytes([c]))
        if data:
            self.dc(1)
            self.spi.write(data)
        self.cs(1)

    def blit(self, buf, x, y, w, h):
        self._cmd(0x2A, bytes([x >> 8, x & 255, (x + w - 1) >> 8, (x + w - 1) & 255]))
        self._cmd(0x2B, bytes([y >> 8, y & 255, (y + h - 1) >> 8, (y + h - 1) & 255]))
        self._cmd(0x2C, buf)

    def text(self, s, x, y, colour=0xFFFF):
        w = 8 * len(s)
        buf = bytearray(w * 8 * 2)
        fb = framebuf.FrameBuffer(buf, w, 8, framebuf.RGB565)
        fb.text(s, 0, 0, colour)
        self.blit(buf, x, y, w, 8)

from machine import Pin, SPI
from st7789 import ST7789
import time
spi = SPI(1, baudrate=20000000, sck=Pin({SCL}), mosi=Pin({SDA}))
tft = ST7789(spi, {DC}, {CS}, {RES})
time.sleep(1)
tft.text('HELLO 42', 20, 40)
